methodologyNotes: This dataset covers 13 camping and backpacking sleeping bags (one of which is a quilt, flagged in specs and shape) across a wide price and performance range. Sourced from manufacturer product pages (Kelty, NEMO, Western Mountaineering, Big Agnes, Enlightened Equipment, Marmot, Coleman, TETON), major retailer listings (REI), and independent review publications (Advnture, CleverHiker, Backpacking Light). Specs reflect the men's regular size where size variants exist; weight is the manufacturer-listed minimum/packed weight. Zipper side is reported as stated by manufacturer or authoritative retailer; null when not determinable. priceUsd is the published US MSRP or current list price found on the manufacturer or primary retailer page, in USD; null when no published USD price could be corroborated. All accessedAt = 2026-06-20. Adversarial re-verification corrected the TNF Cat's Meow price (Advnture's $169 was stale; current REI/market price is ~$200) and the TETON Celsius XXL 20F packed size (draft used the lighter Grand XXL variant's 19x11.5x11.5; the XXL 20F packs to 22x15.25x15.5).
